workshoptitle: Migrate Red Hat Enterprise Linux to Oracle Linux: Student Workshop

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the student environment, prerequisites, lab order, and migration success criteria.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build and Verify the Migration Environment
tutorials.description: Create the destination VCN and access rules, import the instructor-provided image, launch a VM, and verify the application and registration cleanup.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Linux Command-Line Quickstart
tutorials.description: Practice everyday commands and produce a readiness report.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Assess Readiness and Protect the Source
tutorials.description: Capture the destination baseline, assess readiness, and choose an optional backup.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Migrate to Oracle Linux
tutorials.description: Convert in place, reboot into Oracle RHCK, and verify the application.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Validate the Migration
tutorials.description: Compare migration evidence and review package exceptions before further practice.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Explore Oracle Linux Kernel Choices
tutorials.description: Install and boot UEK 8, retain RHCK as fallback, and retest the migrated application.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Explore Rebootless Patching with Ksplice
tutorials.description: Check eligibility, install Uptrack, evaluate available live patches, and compare boot identity and application observations.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Prepare OS Management Hub for On-Premises Management
tutorials.description: Verify OSMH access, the instructor-prepared on-premises station, mirrored content, and client readiness.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Register an On-Premises Oracle Linux Client
tutorials.description: Create the non-OCI client profile, activate Management Agent, and verify registration, sources, and Apache.

tutorials.title: Lab 10: Patch and Verify Oracle Linux with OS Management Hub
tutorials.description: Apply an available update, plan maintenance, inspect job outcomes, and preserve application and management evidence.

tutorials.title: Reference: On-Premises Management Agent
tutorials.description: Shared installation and activation procedure for the on-premises station and clients.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Review common solutions and options for assistance.
